name: Slotlight
author: E. T. Carter
description: A low view up a narrow, twisting sandstone slot canyon: fluted walls swept by flowing strata glow pale coral under a thin white slit of sky and sink through wine into near-black shade, with rippled sand on the floor below. Faint blades of dusty sunlight fan down from the slit and swing slowly as the view creeps forward between the walls.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How fast the view creeps up the canyon and the shafts swing.

params.label: Strata
params.effect: Density of the sandstone beds and ledges on the walls.

params.label: Dust
params.effect: How much dust lights up inside the sun shafts.

params.label: Bounce
params.effect: How far the bounced sunlight reaches down the walls before cold shade takes over.
